name: Build and Deploy Code

on : [push, pull_request]

#to put env store in setting - secrets
# or create an environment in settings and put all secrets over there
jobs:
  job1:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: pulling git repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        #this is just a github action which is a shorter version of steps we need to do
      - name: Say Hi to Abishek
        run: echo "hello Abishek"
      
# the biggst problem is no database exists, so we need to create a service container of postgres

# Make changes to code                 CI
# Commit changes  -------------------> Pull source code
#                                         Install Dependencies
#                                     Run Automated Tests       CD
#                                     Build Image ---------> Grabs Images
#                                                             Update Production
# Run Tests
# Build Image
# Deploy
# Left side is manual

#It is dead simple , you provide steps in yaml or json
